Name: Shane by Xaf
Author: xafynn
Description:
[b]Shane by Xaf[/b] is a portrait mod for Stardew Valley that replaces Shane’s portraits with detailed, high-resolution artwork. Using full portrait sheets, it covers all of Shane’s different moods and expressions, keeping his personality intact but giving him a fresh, updated look. This mod is made to work with the PortraiturePlus framework. 

HOW TO INSTALL:

1. Install portraiture and portraitureplus
2. Install Shane by Xaf
3. Move all 3 to your stardew mods folder
4. When in a dialogue with Shane, press 'P' to switch portraits (may need to press multiple times)
5. Enjoy!
